facts.text: I write about adventure, not eating dinner in a jungle with no heels left. Pass the bread anyway.
facts.why: Not a Joan line. Her real line about the heels is 'These were Italian.' (after Jack chops them off). The note is also built on 'boots', which is wrong, see the winks.
facts.fix: Jack chopped the heels off my shoes in the jungle. The least this place can do is feed me. Pass the bread.

fix_note.text: Jack chopped the heels off my shoes in the jungle. The least this place can do is feed me. Pass the bread.

facts.why: The map is mailed by Eduardo, Elaine's husband and Joan's murdered brother-in-law. Elaine is kidnapped in Colombia and phones Joan afterwards.

facts.text: Jack chops the heels off Joan's boots.
facts.why: Joan is in shoes, not boots. On Wikiquote she says 'These were Italian' after Jack chops the heels off her shoes. Same line is in the venue winks.
facts.fix: Jack chops the heels off Joan's shoes
facts.applied_note: Stored without the full stop, as the other winks are.

facts.text: Joan's sister Elaine in New York
facts.why: Elaine is in Colombia, kidnapped by Ira and Ralph, and handed over in Cartagena. She is not in New York.
facts.fix: Joan's sister Elaine, held in Cartagena
